Kokoro JS 1.2.1; Transformers.js; phonemizer; ONNX Runtime Web.
Kokoro-82M model: https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX
Model/voice origins: https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M
The Kokoro voice loader is modified to load same-origin voice assets.
Worker source and build instructions: tools/browser-voices in this public repository.
